newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin health satisfactory, recovers well--doctor.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin health satisfactory, recovers well--doctor.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin is in satisfactory condition after heart surgery and is on target to return to the Kremlin as planned in six to eight weeks, his chief doctor said on Monday.
"The condition of Boris Nikolayevich is satisfactory," Sergei Mironov, the main Kremlin doctor, told a news conference six days after Yeltin's quintuple heart bypass operation on November 5.
He said the 65-year-old president's temperature had been normal for four days, his appetite was returning and he was able to walk or sit up for six hours a day.

Mironov said Yeltsin would probably spend up to two more weeks in Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital and a month in the Barvikha sanatorium just outside Moscow where he spent much of the time when he was preparing for the operation.
He declined to set any dates but said Yeltsin's progress was normal and that he was still following the timetable set out in many interviews by the surgeons who carried out the operation.
"I think that for the time being we are going according to the existing norms. I think the process of rehabilitation in the clinic and sanatorium will last about 1-1/2 months to two months," he said.
But he added a word of caution, saying the doctors were more interested in Yeltsin's long-term recovery than setting any short-term goals.
"We want to go a marathon distance of 10, 12, 15 years. Of course you can set a new world record...but we are not setting ourselves such a goal," he said.
"Our basic task, as we said earlier, is restoring the president's real work capacity."
Dcotors see Yeltsin every day at the Central Clinical Hospital and meet to discuss his condition.
"He is already asking quite a lot of questions about the details of the operation and its technical aspects," Mironov said.
He said Yeltsin would be able to work for at least eight hours a day when he had completed his recovery.

Yeltsin had two heart attacks last year and one of his doctors said he probably had a third just before his re-election on July 3. He has spent only a handful of days in the Kremlin since he was re-elected.
